business_summary: A brand that makes non-alcoholic sparkling drinks with adaptogens, positioned as a functional cocktail alternative for people who want to feel good without a hangover.
stated_claims: For people who want to feel good without a hangover

relevant_tags.why: Core category: the product is a drink.
Core category: contains adaptogens and is positioned as a functional alternative.
Adjacent interest: sparkling non-alcoholic drink can serve as an alternative to soda or cocktails.
Weak fit: positioned as an alternative to alcohol/cocktails.

note_signals.why: High-frequency impulse shoppers and late-night traffic are a great fit for a non-alcoholic cocktail alternative.
Audience consists of health-curious, indulgence-seeking shoppers with strong overlap in functional beverages and soda alternatives.

gate_reason: Product and audience are clear enough to plan campaign targeting, though price and purchase model remain unstated.
